sourceFiles.claim: Mastra Config exposes per-instance agents, tools, workflows, memory, storage, pubsub, workers and scheduler, plus role-local lookup APIs.
Mastra allocates registries, storage, pubsub, schedules and workers per instance, attaches configured Agents, and starts workers with that instance's storage and pubsub.
An attached Agent resolves its own or inherited Mastra pubsub, passes it to thread-stream operations, and only an unattached Agent creates an ephemeral in-memory Mastra fallback.
AgentThreadStreamRuntime is a module singleton whose mutable state is keyed by PubSub identity, with a module-default EventEmitterPubSub used only when no explicit pubsub is supplied.
EventEmitterPubSub owns strictly in-process emitter and batching state on each constructed PubSub object.
The public Schedules API is constructed with a Mastra instance and exposes create, get, list, update and delete over role-owned schedule storage.
The public Scheduler contract receives SchedulesStorage and PubSub dependencies rather than a process-global role registry.
The scheduler implementation claims due schedule rows through its supplied storage and publishes workflow events through its supplied PubSub.
AgentScheduleWorker consumes the Mastra, storage and PubSub dependencies supplied by its owning worker instance and records schedule triggers through that storage.
Evaluation, generation and scorer hooks use one module-level mitt emitter with explicit register, deregister and execute functions.
DurableAgent uses a module-global TTL globalRunRegistry keyed by runId for non-serializable active-run state and a PubSub stream adapter.
Observational Memory uses a module-level activeOps map and static BufferingCoordinator maps shared across all OM instances in the process.
The public OM operation-registry declaration explicitly defines a process-level registry for reflecting, observing and buffering operations.
Postgres storage carries schemaName into schema-qualified tables and exposes the schedules storage domain used by the role-owned Mastra store.

instanceLocalSurfaces.surface: Mastra agent registry and Agent attachment
instanceLocalSurfaces.reason: The Mastra instance owns its private agent registry and invokes Agent.__registerMastra(this); F1 uses separate Builder and PAR Agent objects attached to separate Mastra instances.

instanceLocalSurfaces.surface: Mastra tool registry and Agent tool surface
instanceLocalSurfaces.reason: Tools are registered into the owning Mastra instance and attached Agents resolve their role-local tool set; F1 uses direct code-defined Release-derived tools.
Workflows are stored in the owning Mastra instance and receive that instance's storage; F1 uses a named deterministic workflow only for the scheduler-to-PAR ingress seam.

instanceLocalSurfaces.surface: Mastra memory registry and configured Memory instances
instanceLocalSurfaces.reason: Memory instances are registered and attached through the owning Mastra instance; F1 enables only the admitted conversation/thread substrate with explicit owner-derived scopes.

instanceLocalSurfaces.surface: Configured persistent storage and PostgreSQL schema binding
instanceLocalSurfaces.reason: Each Mastra holds its configured storage object, and the admitted PostgreSQL realization carries an explicit schemaName; F1 assigns separate role stores/schemas.

instanceLocalSurfaces.surface: Explicit role-configured PubSub and EventEmitterPubSub instances
instanceLocalSurfaces.reason: Mastra uses config.pubsub when supplied, otherwise constructs a new EventEmitterPubSub; F1 supplies a distinct explicit PubSub instance per role.

instanceLocalSurfaces.surface: Mastra schedules API, scheduler worker and worker ownership
instanceLocalSurfaces.reason: Schedules are constructed per Mastra and scheduler/worker dependencies are wired from that Mastra's storage and PubSub; F1 uses native scheduler mechanics behind the narrow PAR ingress.
The worker exists and is instance-wired, but F1 does not admit stock direct Agent schedule dispatch because schedule fire must enter through the guarded PAR ingress.

enabledProcessGlobalSurfaces.surface: AgentThreadStreamRuntime state keyed by PubSub identity
enabledProcessGlobalSurfaces.reason: The runtime singleton is reachable from attached Agents, but its thread/run state lookup and all Agent signal/stream calls receive the resolved role PubSub; distinct role PubSubs are the F1 partition fence.

deferredProcessGlobalSurfaces.reason: The pinned core has a shared hook emitter and Mastra registers scorer hooks, but F1 admits no scorer/evaluation consumer; this surface remains deferred and is not enabled for qualification.

deferredProcessGlobalSurfaces.surface: DurableAgent globalRunRegistry, resumable cache and stream PubSub machinery
deferredProcessGlobalSurfaces.reason: The pinned source has a module-global TTL registry for active DurableAgent run state, with cache/PubSub stream machinery; createDurableAgent and automatic durable recovery are outside the F1 baseline.

deferredProcessGlobalSurfaces.surface: Observational Memory active-operation registry and static buffering maps
deferredProcessGlobalSurfaces.reason: The pinned memory package has process-level activeOps and static buffering coordination shared across OM instances; Observational Memory is OFF until an admitted eval-backed consumer exists.
The module default is selected only when no explicit PubSub reaches the thread runtime; governed F1 role instances explicitly configure their own PubSubs and must produce zero default-bucket traffic.
